text:
rachel: Deploybot auto-paused the rollout for release r-2026-04-21 after latency spike in us-central. Canary latency jumped ~120ms P95. Need triage: rollback full release, rollback model-serving only, or hold and patch?

deploybot: [automated] rollout paused for r-2026-04-21. Trigger: canary p95 latency increase > 80ms over baseline for 10m. Actions: `deployctl abort-canary`, `deployctl pin --prod v2.3.1`, `deployctl resume` require manual OK.

tom: A quick note: difference seems tied to the new batching kernel and persistent KV cache TTL change. Model-serving image has new kernel; mesh config changed too.

priya: If the mesh config is safe, we could try a targeted rollback of only the model-serving image to v2.3.1 and keep other config changes staged. That buys time without a full release revert.

rachel: I like targeted rollback. Lower blast radius. Can you run the rollback commands and validate?

priya: Running now. Commands I'll use: ```
kubectl -n serving set image deploy/model-serving model-serving=redwood/model-serving:v2.3.1
kubectl -n serving rollout status deploy/model-serving --watch
```

ops-bot: Suggestion: post a short status-page note if impact >15m. Also pin release to v2.3.1 while we validate: `deployctl pin --release r-2026-04-21 --version v2.3.1`

tom: Also toggle off the kvcache TTL change in mesh config and rerun canary once model-serving is stable. If latency returns to baseline -> resume staged rollout.

priya: Rollback started at 2911122460. Watching rollout...

deploybot: [automated] detected rollback attempt for model-serving by priya. Canary remains quarantined.

priya: Rollout finished: model-serving at v2.3.1 on canary nodes. Validation: running 5m perf probe and synthetic load.

rachel: I'll draft a short release-note line: "Canary for r-2026-04-21 paused after latency regressions; model-serving rolled back to v2.3.1 while we investigate batching kernel.", and tag INC-2026-167.

ops-bot: Reminder checklist: 
- Pin prod version (recommended)
- Quarantine canary
- Run synthetic perf checks (5m)
- If stable -> schedule controlled canary rerun with kvcache TTL disabled
- If unstable -> prepare full rollback plan and customer comms

priya: Synthetic checks show p95 back to baseline within 3m. No errors observed in routing-mesh.

tom: Great. I'll prepare the config revert (mesh kvcache TTL) and a canary rerun plan with step increments (10%, 25%, 50%). Schedule in 45m.

rachel: Notifying product and CS. I'll update /release-notes and link here: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/r-2026-04-21.md (drafted, includes INC-2026-167).

priya: Pinning prod now. `deployctl pin --release r-2026-04-21 --version v2.3.1` -> done at 2911122650.

deploybot: [automated] action logged: prod pinned to v2.3.1 by priya. Canary quarantined for r-2026-04-21.

rachel: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene before the 45m rerun window. If anything starts rolling forward unexpectedly, ping this thread immediately. :raising_hand:

priya: I'll open a short incident-runbook entry and link PRs for the kernel/batching revert.
